test_title: PYST 8: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Shubham starts from Point A and drives 10 km towards West. He then takes a right turn, drives 8 km, turns right and drives 14 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 12 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degrees turns only unless specified)
solution:
**Given:**

From A → 10 km West

Right turn → 8 km North

Right turn → 14 km East

Right turn → 12 km South

Right turn → 4 km West

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08a43655e7a68c5d8f8e8b73901a6b922a2592f7092aef496926d685dc6cc19d.png] 

**∴ Required shortest distance = 4 km towards North.**

Hence the correct answer is** Option 2.**
